headline: Engineering modern, scalable web solutions with a passion for craftsmanship.
paragraphs: Hello! I am a software engineer dedicated to building performant web applications and intuitive user interfaces. I enjoy transforming complex challenges into elegant, resilient systems.

My journey spans working across the entire web ecosystem—from crafting reactive user interfaces to architecting robust APIs and database structures. I prioritize writing clean, maintainable code with strict type-safety and thorough accessibility.
When I'm not writing code, I love exploring emerging web standards, contributing to open-source discussions, and constantly refining my understanding of system design and user experience.

highlights.title: Clean Architecture
highlights.description: Component-driven design, modular state management, and maintainable TypeScript patterns.

highlights.title: Performance First
highlights.description: Optimized Core Web Vitals, smart asset loading, and high-efficiency rendering pipelines.

highlights.title: Fluid Motion & UX
highlights.description: Thoughtful, accessible animations that bring interfaces to life without causing cognitive friction.

highlights.title: Full-Stack Versatility
highlights.description: Seamless integration between client interfaces, backend services, and structured databases.
